rule: 1. "Master of Science" / "Masters of Science" / "M.S." / "MSc" / "M.S. degree" (after any prefix); ... Ties keep the page order.

name: master_empty_result
rule: Never in the list: an MBA-only option, executive / law / education / engineering / technology / fine-arts masters, and any option whose field is not his.

name: master_combined_arts_or_science

name: master_plain_second_tier_ties
rule: 2. a plain "Master's" / "Masters" / "Master's Degree" / "Graduate Degree"; ... Ties keep the page order.

name: master_abbrev_in_field_form
rule: an option that names a field — "<Master/Bachelor…> [of Science/Arts] in <field>" or "M.S. in <field>" / "B.A. in <field>" — is Joey's only when the field starts with one of his
note: The spec's field rule says "M.S. in <field>" with a his-field is Joey's, but the ranked list only names "Master of Science in <his field>" at rank 3; whether "M.S. in Statistics" sits at rank 3 (as assumed here) or elsewhere is not stated. It must at least outrank nothing here; only its placement relative to "Master of Science" is assumed.

name: bachelor_core_order
rule: bachelor_options(list) returns his bachelor's options, best first: "Bachelor of Arts" / "B.A." (after any prefix) → a plain "Bachelor's (Degree)" or "Bachelor of Arts in Economics" → a combined option naming Arts. A Bachelor of Science alone is never his.

name: bachelor_prefix_ties
rule: "Bachelor of Arts" / "B.A." (after any prefix) ... A Bachelor of Science alone is never his. ... Ties keep the page order.

name: bachelor_specialty_excluded
rule: Specialty bachelor's (fine arts, music, engineering, BBA, technology, …) and options with a field other than economics never appear.

name: bachelor_other_field_excluded
options: B.A. - Bachelor of Arts in Political Science
rule: for a bachelor's, economics. Any other field (Taxation, Finance, Nutrition, Accounting, Engineering, …) is never his and is never chosen. ... Specialty bachelor's ... and options with a field other than economics never appear.

name: bachelor_combined_arts_named
options: B.A. or B.S. - Bachelor of Arts or Bachelor of Science
expect: B.A. or B.S. - Bachelor of Arts or Bachelor of Science
rule: "Bachelor of Arts" / "B.A." (after any prefix) → a plain "Bachelor's (Degree)" or "Bachelor of Arts in Economics" → a combined option naming Arts.

name: bachelor_empty_result
rule: A Bachelor of Science alone is never his. Specialty bachelor's (fine arts, music, engineering, BBA, technology, …) and options with a field other than economics never appear.
